# Coda Connector for Muse

A Muse agent skill that uses your Coda docs like a database: list docs, list tables, read rows, and add rows. Adding a row is a write — the skill confirms the row's cells first; reading needs no confirmation. Honest note: use a read-only token if you only read; generating the token (coda.io/account) is interactive and takes about 5 minutes, and the skill tells you exactly which option to pick. Draft: written from Coda's public API docs, not yet live-tested end-to-end — this listing's unverified status reflects that. No secrets in the repo.
